tei:div.tei:p: legs par bshad pa zla ba'i pho nya'i bsdus don puṇḍa ri ka'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo ārya tā re ye/ gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis ni// srid pa'i sdug bsngal zug ngu kun zhi zhing*/ phan bde dpal gyi go 'phang mchog sbyin pa// rje btsun 'phags mas byang chub bar du skyongs// tshe rabs kun tu 'phags mas rjes bzung zhing*// rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtshor rang dbang bsgyur// yang dag lam bzang 'gro la 'dom mdzad pa// bshes gnyen zla ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te// theg chen lam gyi nyams len ma lus pa// ci bzhin ston pa zla ba'i pho nya yi// bsdus don gsal bar 'di na 'chad pa la// bla ma lha yi tshogs kyi gnang ba stsol// de la 'dir mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa'i rnam thar yongs su ma tshang ba med pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po nyi ma rgyal mtshan la slob dpon chen po tsant+ra go mis dngos su gnang ba'i mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro dri med zla ba'i pho nya sho lo ka brgya'i bdag nyid can 'di nyid 'chad pa la gsum/ dang po mtshan gyi don dang*/ gzhung gi don dang*/ mjug gi don dang gsum las dang po ni/ smra mkhas sogs nas bzhugs so'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis/ bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i tshul dang*/ brtsam bya bstan bcos dngos kyi don gnyis/ dang po la mchod par brjod pa dang*/ skal bzang gi slob ma la nyan par bskul ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ skyabs gnas gcig chog tu nges pas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar gyi lam mkhan gcig pur nges pas phyag 'tshal ba gnyis las/ dang po/ skyabs gnas sogs tshig rkang pa gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ 'di nas sogs rkang pa gnyis/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i slob ma la nyan par gdams pa dang*/ gdams pa de la mngon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag lung dang nyams myong gi tshad ma bzhi dang mi 'gal bas nyams su blang rig par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ kwa ye nyon dang sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/

gnyis pa ni/ snyan nam mi snyan sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ gnyis pa gzhung zab rgyas kyi lam lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgo nas rgyas par bstan pa la gsum/ 'dra min shan 'byed nges pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang de'i bstan pa yid ches nges pa'i chos sgrub pa blo gcig tu gcod dgos par bstan pa dang*/ lam sgrub pa'i sngon du blo sbyong ba dang*/ lam dngos su bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdza' bshes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las brtsam te blo sbyong ba dang*/ rang mtshang gi skyon ngos bzung ste tshe 'di sgrub pa'i blo spang dgos par bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang rgyas par bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ thog med 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la bsam nas tshe 'dir dam pa'i chos sgrub pa dang*/ de ltar ma shes na phyin chad 'khor ba mtha' med du yang skye yang 'khrul bstan pa/ 'khor rtsa rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi thog ma ma rig pa ngos bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ legs par soms dang sogs rkang pa gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ da yang sogs rkang pa gnyis/ gsum pa/ rten 'brel sgyu ma'i sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa rgyas par bstan pa la gnyis/ dang po 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs nas brtsam te rang gi sems sbyong ba dang*/ rang mtshang ngos bzung nas rang skyon spang ba gnyis kyi dang po la brgyad/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rang bzhin las ma thar na zug gzer rgyun mi 'chad pa'i nad pa bzhin nam yang zug ngu mi zad par bstan pa dang*/ dal 'byor kyi lus rten khyad par can thob kyang mi brtan par 'jig sla zhing slar yang rgyus med kyi gnas su 'gro bar bstan pa dang*/ skye ba de yang gar 'gro nges pa med pa dge sdig gi las la rag las par bstan pa dang*/ des na da res 'khor ba'i gnas las 'bros dgos par bstan pa dang*/ snying thag pa nas 'bros na thar ba'i go skabs mchi zhing de dag da lta rang la 'dam khar yod par bstan pa dang*/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' yang dag pa'i man ngag la nyan nas tshul bzhin du ma sgrub na phan med par bstan pa dang*/ bla ma'i gsung la mi rtsi bar dam pa'i mgon dang bral bar bstan pa dang*/ tshul bzhin mi sgrub pa'i gang zag de 'phags pa'i thugs rjes ci yang byar med par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ ji srid gnas ngan sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa 'on kyang da res sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa ni/ ngas mi gsal yang sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa ni/ de las deng sang sogs tshigs bcad gcig lnga pa ni/ nges par snying nas sogs tshigs bcad gcig drug pa ni/ smras khar mi nyan sogs tshigs bcad gcig bdun pa ni/ slar yang nga la sogs tshigs bcad gcig brgyad pa ni/ phyis shig gshin rje'i sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis par rang skyon mtshang nas brus te ngos bzungs zhing spang dgos par bstan pa la gnyis/ rang gi skyon la bsam pa/ nyes pa'i rnam smin bsam pa gnyis/ dang po la drug las/ dang po/ rgyu sdig pa gsog pa la dga' na 'bras bu lus ngan gyi steng du sdug bsngal mi bzad pa'i mer bsregs pa'i dus na 'gyod kyang mi phan par bsam pa ni/ rgyu dus las ngan sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa phyir mar bde sdug ci 'gyur ma bsam nas lus ngag gi sdig pa ci cher spyad na 'ong rgyu sdug bsngal las med par bsam pa ni/ pha rol ci 'gyur sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa ni/ 'di snang tshe 'di sgrub 'dod kyis lugs gnyis kyi bya ba bzhag snying po med par bsam pa ni/ nyon mongs lnga 'bar sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa las ngan de'i 'bras bu ngan song gsum las 'gro sa med par bsam pa ni/ las ngan de 'dra'i sogs tshigs bcad gcig lnga pa ni/ rang gi sdig pa'i las byed pa gzhan gyi mthong thos med na skyon med snyam na las kyi 'bras bu nam yang bslu ba med par bstan pa/ khyod kyi 'di na sogs tshigs bcad gcig drug pa ni/ de'i rgyu mtshan 'god pa/

rgyu kun 'byung gi las sgrub pa mang na 'ong rgyu sdug bsngal bden sa las med par bsam pa/ 'di shed khyod tshe sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa la gnyis/ sdig pa'i rnam smin rang 'bras bstan pa dang*/ de'i gnyen po dge ba'i las la 'bad dgos par bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la gsum/ dang po/ chos med dal khom du 'dug kyang mi rtag 'chi ba'i dbang du 'gro bar bsam pa ni/ khoms khoms 'dug chos sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa shi nas ri gzar gyi rbab rdo bzhin 'gro sa ngan 'gro las med par bsam pa ni/ dgra de'i zhags pas sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa/ des na da res 'khor ba'i brtson ra nas thar ba'i thabs 'bad pas 'tshol dgos par bstan pa ni/ de las da lta sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa la gnyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen brten nas thar ba'i thabs lnga tshan dang po 'tshol dgos par bsam pa dang*/ de'i bstan pa'i lam la ci ltar brtson par bstan pa gnyis kyi dang po la gsum/ dang po/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan bkod pa ni/ ma min rigs ldan sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa yang dag pa'i gdams ngag mi bslu nges pa'i tshad mar bzung dgos par bstan pa ni/ nor med 'chug med sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa bla ma bsten cing gdams pa nyams su blang ba'i byed las bstan pa ni/ srid pa'i 'ching ba sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa gdams pa dngos nyams su len pa la bdun/ dang po/ yon tan thams cad kyi rten gzhi yid ches nges pas dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro dgos par bstan pa ni/ bag chags sgo ba sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa/ theg chen gyi rtsa ba byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ ma nyams na 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi 'phrang las thar nges par bsam pa ni/ theg chen rgyal po sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa de ltar sgrub pa'i thabs lnga mi shes pa'i glen pa rnams ni dam pas thugs kyis khrel zhing skyob pa'i thabs dang bral bar bstan pa ni/

glen pa 'ga' zhig sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa/ khas nyen gyi rnam dbye ma shes na nyes pa'i gnas su bstan pa ni/ mi gtong thur du sogs tshigs bcad gcig lnga pa bla ma dang yang dag pa'i chos dang 'phrad dus yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams rang la rag las par bstan pa/ lha dang bla ma sogs tshigs bcad gcig drug pa rgyu mtshan des na gcig tu chos la brtson na mtho ris dang thar ba'i go 'phang la sbyor ba'i thabs bstan pa ni/ de 'drar ma byed sogs tshigs bcad gnyis/ bdun pa gtan gyi bde ba'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas dang bla ma la yid gtod kyis bsten na 'di phyir bde nas bde bar 'gro bar bstan pa ni/ mnga' bdag btsan po sogs tshigs bcad gcig rtsa ba'i gnyis pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam rnam grangs nyer bzhi'i lnga'i dpyod/ sgo nas bstan pa la gnyis/ dri ba'i sgau nas mtshams sbyar ba/ lan gyi sgo nas rgyas par bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yang khyod thar pa sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa lan gyis rgyas par bshad pa lnga tshan bzhi'i sgo nas lam dang 'bras bu'i chos gnyis bstan pa'i dang po la/ thar ba'i 'gro ba'i lam lnga ngos bzung ba lam rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa la rag las par bshad pa'i dang po la drug dang po lam lnga ngos bzung ba la rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i lam la nang gses nyan thos dang de'i shugs kyi 'phags pa rang rgyal gyi lam dang*/ theg pa chen po'i lam chen po'i lam dngos su bstan pa ni/ rang don yid byed sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa myur lam rdo rje theg pa la/ dka' thub rig byed kyi theg pa phyi rgyud sde gsum/ dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa ma hā dang a nu gnyis/ thabs lam brtul zhugs kyi theg pa gsang chen man ngag a ti yo ga'i theg pa rnams bstan pa ni gsang sngags phyi rgyud sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa de dag dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam du bstan pa ni/

chos kyi sgo 'phar sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa mthar thug 'gal med theg pa gcig tu sgrub pa ni/ kun kyang mngon par sogs tshigs bcad gcig lnga pa rtag chad mthar 'dzin gyi g.yang sa'i lam spang rig par bstan pa ni/ bde nas bde bar sogs tshigs bcad gcig drug pa lam lnga'i bgrod pa myur 'gyogs bul snyam/ kyi khyad dpes bstan pa ni/ 'gal med lam la'ang sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa la dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul la/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid brtags na ci ltar 'chad nyan bgyid pa'i tshul la gnyis/ dang po thar ba'i lam mkhan bla ma bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bkod pa la brgyad/ dang po yang dag pa'i lam mkhan bla ma ma bsten par 'bras bu mi 'grub pa'i tshul/ gang nas phyin sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa so skye dang 'phags pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyis bstan pa ni/ 'phags dang so skye sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa so sor thar ba'i lam gyi bshes gnyen rab tu byung ba gtso bor bstan pa ni/ phyi ma rab tu sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa 'di phyir phongs 'tshengs byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang sdig pa'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam dbye bshad pa ni/ de yang dmar ser sogs tshigs bcad gcig lnga pa tshul bzhin brtags ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs bshad pa ni/ ma brtags gcal 'grog sogs tshigs bcad gcig drug pa sdig pa'i bshes gnyen dang slob dpon bsod nams chung ngu dag 'phrad pa'i rten 'brel ngan pa'i bstanapa'i sel skyon byed pa'i skyon bstan pa ni/ slob dpon byi la sogs tshigs bcad gcig bdun pa dam pa'i brgyud pa khungs nas smos pa ni/ kho bos bshes gnyen sogs tshigs bcad gcig brgyad pa da lta dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po la bsten na de'i yon tan rang rgyud la skye ba'i tshul bstan pa la nang gses bdun/ dang po shing mchog tsandan gyi nags tshal bzhin bshes gnyen bsten dgos par bstan pa ni/

'on kyang nye skor sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa yi dam lha rjes su bzung zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i bshes gnyen bsten dgos par dpes mtshon pa ni/ mi pham nyi ma sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa nye brgyud zab mo gter gyi bka' bab pa dang snyan brgyud bar ma chad pa'i bshes gnyen bsten dgos par mtshon pa ni/ blo bzang rdo rje sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi yon tan tshur mthong gi yul las 'das par bstan pa ni/ skyes bu 'di dag sogs tshigs bcad gcig lnga pa 'dir dngos su ma bstan kyang so sor thar ba'i bshes gnyen brtan mkhas btsun pa phan 'dogs kyi yon tan bzhi ldan/ byang chub sems dpa'i bshes gnyen yon tan bcu ldan/ gsang sngags kyi slob dpon yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams bsten dgos par bstan pa ni/ gzhan yang rin chen sogs tshigs bcad gcig drug pa phyogs ris kyi kha 'dzin spangs nas kun la dag snang sbyang dgos par bstan pa ni/ rgyal sras rnam 'phrul sogs tshigs bcad gcig bdun pa khyad par can dam pa'i chos spyi dang sngags kyi 'brel ba'i bla ma rtag tu spyi bor bsgom zhing dam tshig gi gnas mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung ba'i sgo nas bla ma mnyes par bsten pa'i tshul ni/ sha za srin po sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa la gnyis/ dang po snod yin pa'i mtshan nyid la gnyis/ dang po dam sri mi gzugs su brdzus pa la zab mo'i man ngag bstan na 'di phyir mi rung bar bstan pa ni/ dus ngan slob ma sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa khrims 'chal dam nyams kyi slob ma bsten na nyes pa mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas su dpe don sna tshogs kyis bstan pa ni/ khrims 'chal sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa yang dag pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid bstan nas 'chad nyan bgyi tshul la gsum/

dang po ni gong gi skyon de dag las ldog cing gsung gi bka' bzhin sgrub nas zhal gyis gsung ba'i bdud rtsi bsten dgos par bstan pa ni/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten cing thugs kyi gsang mdzod dam pa lon par gdams pa ni/ lam mkhan bla ma sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa la gnyis/ lnga tshan bzhi pa zab mo'i gdams ngag lnga nyams su len pa dang yi dam gyi lha bsten par gdams pa'o// dang po la nang gses bcu las/ dang po bskyed rim dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa la thabs lam steng 'og gi sgo gnyis dang gsum/ zab mo gcod yul dang gsang chen a ti yo ga shin tu nye ba'i gsang lam du bstan pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs grol lam sogs tshigs bcad gcig zab mo'i lam lnga po zab myur gyi khyad par yod cing gcig mthar phyin na kun rdzogs par bstan pa ni/ man ngag 'di dag sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa de dag gcig la gcig 'brel gyi gnad kyis gzhung re res skal ldan re grol ba'i rgyu mtshan 'god pa ni/ gzhung res mi re sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa rang gi mos pa dang phog pa'i dbang gis gdams ngag gang 'dod pa res grol bar bstan nas/ khyad par rang rang gi me tog phog pa'i chos a ti yo ga la 'jug dgos par bstan pa ni/ des na gang 'dod sogs tshigs bcad gcig lnga pa gsang chen a ti yo ga'i khyad chos 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan dpe don gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa ni/ gsang chen 'od gsal sogs tshigs bcad gcig drug pa de la yang*/ ltar snang dang yang dag pa'i khyad par rigs pas dpyad nas yang dag pa'i lam ma nor bar bsten dgos par bstan pa ni/ o rgyan chos rgyal sogs tshigs bcad gcig bdun pa deng sang ltar snang bcos ma'i snyan brgyud dar bas nor bu dang 'ching bu ma nor ltar pha nor snyan brgyud kyi man ngag rig pas len pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/ phal cher rdo ba sogs tshigs bcad gcig

brgyad pa snyan brgyud rjogs chen man ngag len pa la dang po sgo kun nas thos bsam dang bsags sbyang la brtson dgos par bstan pa ni/ pha phog ster ba'i sogs tshigs bcad gcig dgu pa da lta'i dus na snyan brgyud tshul bzhin ma nor ba yang rigs pa'i lam nas 'tshol ba rnyed pa nyams su blang ba rnams dus dbang gis shin tu dka' ba'i gnas su bstan pa/ ma rnyed bar du sogs tshigs bcad gcig bcu pa man ngag zab mo thob kyang chos rtsis med pa shes mod mod don staur ba dam pa'i thugs kyis khrel gnas su bstan pa ni/ man ngag mkha' 'gro'i sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa lnga tshan lnga pa bka' gdams lha bzhi'i 'dam nga dang mtshung par 'dir yang de bzhin du ston pa la/ mdor bstan dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po/ da ni bshes gnyen sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ bsgrub bya'i lha mtshan nas bstan pa/ de sgrub pa'i tshul/ ltar snang bcos ma'i lam la snying po med par bstan pa'o// dang po thugs rje chen po dang sgrol ma gu ru rin po che dang gsum gangs can gyi lha'i skal bar ched du bsngags pa ni/ po ṭa la sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa sgrub pa'i thabs la brgyad kyi dang po ni/ de ltar sgrub mi shes pa phyugs las blun par bstan pa/ khong gsum khyad par sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa de bzhin du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang phyag na rdo rje ste rigs gsum sems dpa'i rnam par bzhugs pa de dag bsgrub na rgyal ba thams cad 'dus par bstan pa ni/ rgya yul ri bo sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa de dag las rang gi mos pa dang me tog phog pa'i lha gtso bor bzung dgos par bstan pa ni/ bshes gnyen lha sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa de ltar lhag pa'i lha sgrub pa la zhal mthong gdams ngag 'dri chog pa'i bar gus pas brtson 'grus lhod med du sgrub dgos pa'i tshul ni/ tshe rabs las lha sogs tshigs bcad gcig

lnga pa lha sgrub kyi ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa rtse gcig pa'i man ngag dang mi ldan na sgrub pa don med du bstan pa ni/ man ngag cho ga sogs tshigs bcad gcig drug pa des na brtson pas tshul bzhin sgrub na mi 'grub mi srid par bstan pa ni/ tshul bzhin bsgrub na sogs tshigs bcad gcig bdun pa de ltar lha lnga po ye shes kyi dgongs klong gcig par ma shes nas phyogs ris kyis bzang ngan bstod smad byas na yi dam lhas spangs shing 'gro sa ngan song las med par bstan pa ni/ ye shes lha la sogs tshigs bcad gcig brgyad pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor lha gcig 'bad pas sgrub pa mthar skyol bar du sgrub dgos par bstan pa ni/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa la gsum/ dang po ltar snang chos brgyad kyi sgrub pa don med pas thabs kyi gtso bo bzhi bstan pa ni/ ltar snang chos brgyad sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa man ngag des thog tu bzhag nas bzlas pa'i 'bras bu tshe 'dir gtad pa rnams dus snyigs ma'i rang mtshang du bstan pa ni/ man ngag dpe gog sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa la gsum/ dang po ni/ bshad sgrub sgom pa'i gol sa bcad ma shes na 'os med kyi mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab par bstan pa ni/ bshad lugs ma shes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa lam bskyed rdzogs las mos gus gsol 'debs kyi lam khyer lhag par bstan pa ni/ a la bsgrub lugs sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa mos gus bla ma'i gsol 'debs zab pa'i rgyu mtshan 'god pa ni/ rnam rtog rlabs kyis sogs tshigs bcad gcig da ni rtsa ba'i gnyis pa 'bras bu lam lnga'i rnam bzhag bstan pa la gnyis/ 'bras bu lam lnga mdor bstan/ rnam mkhyen mi slob pa'i 'bras bu rgyas par bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po la gsum/ dang po tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi 'bras bu bstan pa ni/ skyid mgo dang po sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa mthong sgom mi slob lam gyi 'bras bu gsum dpes mtshon pa ni/

mthong ba'i lam du sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa spro dgas nyams su len rigs par bstan pa la bzhi/ dang po zab mo'i lam dang 'phrad par dka' bas da res yang dag pa'i lam gyi mig rnyed dus spro dga' bskyed rigs par bstan pa/ bkra shis nyi 'char sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa 'jig rten gnyen 'dun thar ba'i lam rnal ma dang 'gal bar bstan pa ni/ 'khor ba'i 'ching sbyor sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa blang dor gyi lam shes nas sgrub pa la sras bcas rgyal ba dgyes par bstan pa ni/ shes med byis pa'i sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa thams cad kyi don bsdus te bstan pa ni/ thar ba'i thabs lnga sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa 'bras bu rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ 'bras bu gdams ngag nyams su len pa la rag las pas 'brel ba sgrub pa dang*/ 'bras bu dngos bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ gdams ngag mun khang gi sgron ma ltar thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod cing lam mkhan bshes gnyen ltar gces spras kyi 'tshol dgos par bstan pa ni/ lha dbu dkar chung sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa shes nas nyams su blang bas gong ma'i yon tan rang rgyud la skye ba'i tshul bstan pa/ smra mkhas zla ba'i sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa mi slob pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob tshul la bdun las/ dang po gnas gang du 'tshang rgya na 'og min chen po'i gnas bstan pa ni/ 'chi med lta na sogs tshigs bcad gcig gnyis pa lha mi'i skye dgu'i bdag po thams cad las sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang chos yon tan khyad par 'phags par bstan pa ni/ nor bu'i cod paṇa sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa rten gang gis 'tshang rgya na sa bcu'i rgyun gyi tha mar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal tshab dam par gyur nas de nas sangs rgyas dgos par bstan pa ni/ gang de'i sras kyi sogs tshigs bcad gcig bzhi pa la nang gses gnyis/

spangs rtogs mthar phyin sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur tshul dang*/ 'jig rten 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po sangs rgyas kyi dpe zlar mi nus par bstan pa'o// dang po mnyam med khams gsum sogs tshig rkang gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ mnga' thang gser gyi sogs tshig rkang gnyis/ lnga pa de'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa ni/ srid pa'i phun tshogs kun 'jigs bcas rtsod pa sdig pa'i 'bras bu mi rtag g.yo ba'i chos las ldog pa chos sku zhi ba rtag pa dam pa'i go 'phang yin par bstan pa/ rgyal mtshan bcas kyang sogs tshigs bcad gcig drug pa mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de 'bras bu mthar thug pa bla na med pa yin par bstan pa ni/ yang dag thob pa sogs tshigs bcad gcig bdun pa 'bras bu'i chos nyer lnga'i bdag nyid kyi go 'phang mngon du gyur/ gzhan don du rtag khyab lhun grub pa'i phrin las kyis nam mkha' ji srid du sems can gyi 'dren par 'gyur bar bstan pa ni/ lnga lnga'i tshig gis sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa mjug gi don la gsum/ dang po de ltar brtsams pa legs pa'i dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ dpal stong mnga' ba sogs tshig rkang gnyis/ gnyis pa shis pa brjod pas dge legs su bya ba la gnyis/ dang po mdor bstan pa ni/ don gnyis mthar phyin sogs tshig rkang gnyis/ gnyis pa nyid kyi thugs dam 'phags mas rang gzhan rnam kun bde ba'i bkra shis kyi mchog sbyin stsol bar gsol ba ni/ mdzes mdzes mtho ris sogs tshigs bcad gcig gsum pa gnas gang du dus gang gi tshe mdzad pa po rgyal sras rdo rje zla ba nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa ni/ ces bkra shis bshad sgrub sogs kyis bstan pa'o// de ltar legs bshad zla ba'i pho nya 'di// zab 'dreil mdo sngags lam gnad kun 'dus shing*// 'phags pa'i zhal lung snga na med pa yi// ngo mtshar tshig don mkhas pas 'jal na rtogs// skal bzang skye dgu thar ba'i go 'phang la// bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs rgyal sras skyed mo'i tshal// yang dag lam bzang 'khrul ba med pa la// dpyod ldan blo gros ldan pa su mi 'jug

/de slad 'di na rang blo'i nus pa'i tshod// bsdus don puṇṭa ri ka'i phreng ba bkod// bla ma lha bcas mnyes pa bsgrub pa'i phyir// dpyad gsum dag pa'i tshad mas phul ba dge /ces pa'ang mchog gzigs sprul pa'i sku nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis gnang ba'i legs bshad chen po zhal gdams dri med zla ba'i pho nya'i bsdus don zhig dgos par rje nyid kyi zhal slob dam par gyur pa a dzi rong pa bla ma blo khos bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal kaḥthog pa chen po'i chos kyi khri 'dzin pa chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos sug bris su spel ba dge legs su gyur cig// /
